country.title: Legal-address country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. SG, US, GB, DE)

entityCategory.description: Sole-proprietor records are not part of this product. Empty = all shipped categories.
entityCategory.title: Entity category (exact, e.g. GENERAL, FUND, BRANCH, RESIDENT_GOVERNMENT_ENTITY, INTERNATIONAL_ORGANIZATION)

hasDirectParent.description: true = only entities with a reported direct consolidation parent; false = only entities without one.
hasDirectParent.title: Has a direct parent (leave unset for all)

hasUltimateParent.description: true = only entities with a reported ultimate consolidation parent; false = only entities without one.
hasUltimateParent.title: Has an ultimate parent (leave unset for all)

jurisdiction.description: GLEIF Legal Jurisdiction code. Empty = all jurisdictions.
jurisdiction.title: Legal jurisdiction (exact, e.g. SG, US-DE, GB)

legalFormCode.description: ISO 20275 Entity Legal Form code. Empty = all legal forms.
legalFormCode.title: Legal form code (ELF code, exact)

limit.description: Caps the number of entity rows written to the dataset.
limit.title: Maximum rows to return

managingLou.title: Managing LOU (LEI of the Local Operating Unit, exact)

mode.description: entities: one dataset row per entity matching the filters. analytics: a single ANALYTICS row in the run's key-value store (dataset stays empty). both: entity rows plus the ANALYTICS record in the key-value store.
mode.title: Mode

registrationAuthorityId.description: The register the entity is filed with (GLEIF registration-authority list). Empty = all authorities.
registrationAuthorityId.title: Registration authority ID (exact, e.g. RA000001)
